# SEO-168: Render structured data in the server response

This page is generated from the canonical JSONL registry record. Edit the JSONL record and run `npm run docs -- --write`; do not edit this file directly.

## Statement

The JSON-LD block is present in the response body as delivered, rather than injected by client script after load, and the block present after hydration is identical to the one delivered.

## Rationale

Markup that only exists after script execution is absent from the response any consumer reads without rendering, and a block written twice by server and client produces two competing descriptions of the same entity.

## Applicability

```json
{
  "all": [
    "public_site"
  ],
  "any": [
    "client_rendered",
    "javascript_app"
  ]
}
```

## Implementation

Emit the block from the server render path alongside the content it describes. If a client-side library currently injects it, remove that injection rather than leaving both in place, and compute the values on the server from the same data the page renders.

## Verification

- Level: `SOURCE_AND_RUNTIME`
- Method: Diff the JSON-LD blocks found in the unexecuted response body against those present in the hydrated document.
- Evidence: `RAW_HTML`, `JSON_LD`, `BROWSER`
- Automated check: none.

- Frameworks: `react-spa`, `vite`, `next-app-router`, `next-pages-router`, `astro`, `remix`, `sveltekit`, `nuxt`
